```{r}
# =========================================================
# make_colored_stimuli_exp1.R
#
# Creates colored versions of Exp1 transparent stimulus PNGs
# based on their feature values.
#
# PLACE THIS SCRIPT IN:
#   ROP_Curvature/Exp1/figures/
#
# INPUT:
#   stimuli/
#
# OUTPUT:
#   stimuli_colored/nv/
#   stimuli_colored/ang/
#   stimuli_colored/sm/
#
# Expected filename pattern:
#   stim_nv1_ang45_s0.0_rot+000.png
#   stim_nv2_ang90_s0.8_rot-045.png
#   stim_nv3_ang135_s1.4_rot+135.png
#
# Note:
#   Exp1 image filenames encode smoothness as:
#     s0.0 -> sm0
#     s0.8 -> sm1
#     s1.4 -> sm2
#
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(magick)
  library(stringr)
  library(fs)
})

# -----------------------------
# PATHS
# -----------------------------
input_dir  <- "stimuli"
output_dir <- "stimuli_colored"

output_nv_dir  <- file.path(output_dir, "nv")
output_ang_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "ang")
output_sm_dir  <- file.path(output_dir, "sm")

dir_create(output_nv_dir, recurse = TRUE)
dir_create(output_ang_dir, recurse = TRUE)
dir_create(output_sm_dir, recurse = TRUE)

# -----------------------------
# FIXED COLOR MAPS
# -----------------------------
nv_colors <- c(
  `1` = "#4E79A7",
  `2` = "#F28E2B",
  `3` = "#59A14F"
)

ang_colors <- c(
  `45`  = "#4E79A7",
  `90`  = "#F28E2B",
  `135` = "#59A14F"
)

sm_colors <- c(
  `0` = "#4E79A7",
  `1` = "#F28E2B",
  `2` = "#59A14F"
)

# -----------------------------
# HELPER: map filename smoothness code to sm level
# -----------------------------
map_s_value_to_sm <- function(s_val) {
  if (s_val == "0.0") return("0")
  if (s_val == "0.8") return("1")
  if (s_val == "1.4") return("2")
  return(NA_character_)
}

# -----------------------------
# HELPER: parse filename
# -----------------------------
parse_features_from_filename <- function(filename) {
  # Examples:
  # stim_nv1_ang45_s0.0_rot+000.png
  # stim_nv2_ang90_s0.8_rot-045.png
  # stim_nv3_ang135_s1.4_rot+135.png

  pattern <- "^stim_nv([0-9]+)_ang([0-9]+)_s([0-9]+\\.[0-9]+)_rot[+-][0-9]{3}\\.png$"
  m <- str_match(filename, pattern)

  if (all(is.na(m))) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  s_raw <- m[4]
  sm <- map_s_value_to_sm(s_raw)

  if (is.na(sm)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  list(
    nv    = m[2],
    ang   = m[3],
    s_raw = s_raw,
    sm    = sm
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# HELPER: recolor PNG while preserving alpha
# -----------------------------
recolor_png_keep_alpha <- function(input_path, output_path, fill_color) {
  img <- image_read(input_path)

  info <- image_info(img)
  width <- info$width[1]
  height <- info$height[1]

  solid <- image_blank(width = width, height = height, color = fill_color)

  alpha <- image_fx(img, expression = "a")

  colored <- image_composite(solid, alpha, operator = "copyopacity")

  image_write(colored, path = output_path, format = "png")
}

# -----------------------------
# GET FILES
# -----------------------------
files <- dir_ls(input_dir, regexp = "\\.png$", type = "file")

if (length(files) == 0) {
  stop("No PNG files found in: ", normalizePath(input_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))
}

cat("Found", length(files), "PNG files in", normalizePath(input_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE), "\n")

# -----------------------------
# PROCESS FILES
# -----------------------------
n_done <- 0
n_skipped <- 0

for (input_path in files) {
  filename <- path_file(input_path)
  parsed <- parse_features_from_filename(filename)

  if (is.null(parsed)) {
    message("Skipping file with unexpected name format: ", filename)
    n_skipped <- n_skipped + 1
    next
  }

  nv_val  <- parsed$nv
  ang_val <- parsed$ang
  sm_val  <- parsed$sm

  nv_color  <- nv_colors[[nv_val]]
  ang_color <- ang_colors[[ang_val]]
  sm_color  <- sm_colors[[sm_val]]

  if (is.null(nv_color) || is.null(ang_color) || is.null(sm_color)) {
    message("Skipping file with unmapped feature value: ", filename)
    n_skipped <- n_skipped + 1
    next
  }

  out_nv  <- file.path(output_nv_dir, filename)
  out_ang <- file.path(output_ang_dir, filename)
  out_sm  <- file.path(output_sm_dir, filename)

  recolor_png_keep_alpha(input_path, out_nv,  nv_color)
  recolor_png_keep_alpha(input_path, out_ang, ang_color)
  recolor_png_keep_alpha(input_path, out_sm,  sm_color)

  n_done <- n_done + 1
}

# -----------------------------
# SUMMARY
# -----------------------------
cat("\nDone.\n")
cat("Processed:", n_done, "files\n")
cat("Skipped:", n_skipped, "files\n")
cat("\nCreated folders:\n")
cat(" -", normalizePath(output_nv_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE), "\n")
cat(" -", normalizePath(output_ang_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE), "\n")
cat(" -", normalizePath(output_sm_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE), "\n")
```
